title: FAO - Agroforestry
source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
text: Agroforestry integrates trees with crops and/or livestock and can contribute to soil protection, biodiversity, microclimate regulation and diversified production.

title: FAO - Conservation Agriculture
source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
text: Conservation agriculture emphasizes minimum soil disturbance, permanent soil cover and crop diversification to support soil health and resource conservation.

title: FAO - Soil Biodiversity
source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
text: Soil organisms support nutrient cycling, decomposition and other ecosystem functions; soil management affects soil biodiversity.

title: IPCC - Climate Change and Land
text: Land management, climate change, soil carbon, vegetation and biodiversity are interconnected; sustainable land management can reduce degradation and support ecosystem functions.

title: IPBES - Global Assessment
source: Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services
text: Land-use change is a major pressure on terrestrial biodiversity, while habitat connectivity and ecosystem condition influence biodiversity outcomes.
